title: PriceDecision
description: The output of the Flink pricing engine for one apartment and one target night. Written to both DynamoDB (hot path) and Iceberg (audit trail). Every field must be present so that the property manager can reconstruct exactly why a price was set, months later.

decision_component.description: One structured reason code explaining part of a pricing decision (ADR-0011 backlog #4).

code.description: Stable across specific attribute values — the specific value observed (which tier, which rating) lives in label, not in a proliferating enum.

label.description: Human-readable, carries the specific value (e.g. "Rating 4.8 vs baseline 4.0").

impact.description: Signed magnitude; unit is contextual to code's family — a signed adjustment fraction for property_* codes (e.g. +0.30 for luxury), a signed EUR gap for rule_* codes (e.g. the amount the cost floor exceeds the property reference price for rule_cost_protected).

decision_id.description: Idempotency key for Iceberg and DynamoDB sinks.

apartment_reference.description: Human-readable property code (e.g. BCN-042). Denormalised here so audit records are self-contained.

target_date.description: The specific night this price recommendation applies to (check-in date).

decided_at.description: Timestamp when the Flink job produced this decision.

cost_inputs.description: Cost snapshot used in this calculation. Aggregated by Flink from payment_line events for the billing period, split by cost_type (ADR-0009).

total_monthly_cost_eur.description: Sum of amount_gross for all payment lines for this apartment in the billing period, regardless of cost_type. Informational rollup, not used directly in the formula.

available_days.description: Number of days in the billing period the apartment is available for rent (not blocked or under maintenance).

fixed_cost_eur.description: Cf: sum of cost_type=fixed lines / available_days. Incurred whether or not the apartment is booked (ADR-0009).

variable_cost_eur.description: Cv: sum of cost_type=variable lines / available_days. Scales with occupancy (ADR-0009).

one_time_cost_eur.description: Cr: average (not sum) of cost_type=one_time lines in the period — each is already the cost of one turnover (ADR-0009).

cost_lines_count.description: Number of payment_line events that contributed to total_monthly_cost_eur. Used to detect incomplete cost data.

market_inputs.description: Market snapshot used in this calculation. From the most recent market_price event for this apartment's market area and target_date.

collected_at.description: Freshness indicator. Stale market data (>48h) should be flagged.

data_age_seconds.description: Seconds between collected_at and decided_at, computed inline at decision time. Cheaper, always-present companion to the separate data_stale side-output, which only fires past the 48h dead-man's-switch threshold (see ADR-0007).

calculation.description: Step-by-step trace of how the price was derived. Fully reproducible from the inputs above.

target_margin.description: Configured minimum profit margin. Set per apartment or globally. Reduced by reduced_margin_factor (0.75) in the structural_reduced_margin band (ADR-0009).

minimum_price_eur.description: The active profitability floor for a 1-night stay (ADR-0009, ADR-0011 backlog #1) — whichever formula floor_type selects. structural_*: (fixed_cost_eur + variable_cost_eur + one_time_cost_eur) / (1 - margin - commission_pct). contribution: (variable_cost_eur + one_time_cost_eur) / (1 - commission_pct), no margin term. The absolute floor for its tier at stay_length=1 — no price below this. See los_floor_matrix for the same floor at other candidate stay lengths (one_time_cost_eur amortizes across the stay; fixed/variable costs do not, since they're already per-night rates).

floor_type.description: Which floor formula produced minimum_price_eur, selected by days_to_arrival (ADR-0009): structural_full_margin (>30 days), structural_reduced_margin (15-30 days, margin × 0.75), contribution (<15 days, no margin term — only variable + one-time costs and commission).

floor_policy.description: Classifies floor_type into the external spec's Hard/Soft floor vocabulary (ADR-0011 backlog #10): hard for contribution (the absolute, never-crossed floor), soft for either structural_* tier (a margin target, relaxable by antelación).

commission_pct.description: Cp: blended OTA/payment-processing commission, set per apartment contract (default 0.15). In the floor's denominator — it scales with the final price (ADR-0009).

commission_base.description: Which revenue base commission_pct is charged against (ADR-0011 backlog #5, owner_contracts). total_revenue reproduces this project's pre-Phase-11 behavior exactly; the other two net ota_fee/channel_manager (and cleaning) out of the base, reducing minimum_price_eur — see calculation.decision_components' commission_base_netting entry when this happens.

days_to_arrival.description: target_date minus the date this decision was made. Selects floor_type (ADR-0009).

competitiveness_discount.description: Fraction below market average to stay competitive (e.g. 0.05 = 5% below avg). Set per apartment or globally.

property_attribute_factor.description: Property Bonus/Malus multiplier applied to avg_nightly_rate_eur, derived from this apartment's quality_tier/rating/has_view/has_parking (ADR-0011 backlog #6, flink_jobs/property_attributes.py). 1.0 is neutral.

property_reference_price_eur.description: avg_nightly_rate_eur × property_attribute_factor. This apartment's market reference, before the competitiveness discount — replaces the raw segment average as the basis for market_reference_price_eur, rule_applied, and below_market_by (ADR-0011 backlog #6).

market_reference_price_eur.description: property_reference_price_eur × (1 - competitiveness_discount). The market-derived target price.

rule_applied.description: market_competitive: minimum_price_eur <= market_reference_price_eur, competitive pricing applied. minimum_floor: market_reference_price_eur < minimum_price_eur <= property_reference_price_eur, the cost floor won but the apartment is still at or below its (attribute-adjusted) market reference. cost_protected: minimum_price_eur > property_reference_price_eur, the cost floor pushed the price above the apartment's market reference — the property's costs are pricing it out of its own market; the only levers are lowering target_margin or discontinuing the listing (ADR-0007, ADR-0011).

los_floor_matrix.description: The same decide_price() evaluation at other candidate stay lengths (ADR-0011 backlog #1) — property_attribute_factor/property_reference_price_eur/market_reference_price_eur/below_market_by are identical across every entry (they never depend on stay_length), so they aren't repeated here. The stay_length=1 entry matches this calculation's own minimum_price_eur/floor_type/rule_applied and the top-level output's suggested_price_eur/effective_margin exactly.

stay_length.description: Candidate LOS this entry evaluates, in nights.

minimum_price_eur.description: The floor at this stay_length — one_time_cost_eur amortized across the stay, fixed/variable costs unchanged (they're already per-night).

floor_type.description: Unaffected by stay_length — selected by days_to_arrival, same for every entry in one decision.

floor_policy.description: This candidate's own floor_type classified into Hard/Soft (ADR-0011 backlog #10) — see calculation.floor_policy.

rule_applied.description: Can genuinely differ per entry — a longer stay's diluted floor can flip cost_protected into market_competitive.

suggested_price_eur.description: What this LOS candidate would be priced at.

effective_margin.description: Varies per entry — the per-night total cost this margin is computed against changes with stay_length.

decision_components.description: This candidate's own rule-decision component only (ADR-0011 backlog #4) — never the property Bonus/Malus block, which doesn't vary with stay_length and already lives once on the top-level calculation.decision_components.
Structured reason codes explaining this decision (ADR-0011 backlog #4): the four Property Bonus/Malus contributions plus the one rule-decision component for this stay_length=1 calculation.

output.description: The recommendation the property manager sees.

suggested_price_eur.description: max(minimum_price_eur, market_reference_price_eur). The final recommended nightly rate.

effective_margin.description: (suggested_price_eur / total_cost_eur) - 1, where total_cost_eur = fixed_cost_eur + variable_cost_eur + one_time_cost_eur. The actual margin this price achieves.

below_market_by.description: property_reference_price_eur - suggested_price_eur (ADR-0011 backlog #6; was avg_nightly_rate_eur - suggested_price_eur before Phase 8). Positive means priced below this apartment's market reference; negative means priced above it (expected for rule_applied=cost_protected). Always computed — never null, since a price_decision is never emitted without market_inputs (ADR-0007).
